Grant all required permissions on first use
Select vehicle to match camera layout
Set video resolution and recording bitrate
Correct fisheye distortion in preview, does not affect recording
Does not affect photos or DingTalk commands
Select storage location for videos and photos
Write to internal storage first, then transfer to USB to avoid recording lag (recommended)
Auto-delete oldest files when limit is exceeded (leave empty or 0 for no limit)
Deletes an extra 20%, e.g. limit 10GB -> cleans until 8GB remains
Show recording time and segment count in top-right (double-tap to toggle)
Add timestamp watermark to saved videos/photos. Video overlay only works in MediaCodec mode (slight performance impact)
Use H.264 fallback (MediaCodec only) to fix flickering/recording failures on some head units with H.265. Default off: uses H.265/HEVC for better compression
Auto launch app after system boot
Auto start recording when app launches. Keeps recording while running (long recording uses significant resources, use with caution)
When enabled, continues recording when screen is off. When disabled, stops 10s after screen off and resumes 10s after screen on

* Permission Settings: Manage all app permissions

* Vehicle Model: Select your vehicle model to match camera layout

* Recording Mode:
 - Auto: Best mode selected automatically per vehicle
 - MediaRecorder: System hardware encoding
 - MediaCodec: Software encoding

* Segment Duration: Max duration per video segment
 - 1 min: Small files, easy to share
 - 3 min: Balance between size and continuity
 - 5 min: Fewer files

* Storage Location:
 - Internal: /DCIM/EVCam_Video/
 - USB: USB/DCIM/ (requires permission)
 - Relay write auto-enabled for USB
 (writes to internal first, transfers async)

* Auto Storage Cleanup:
 - Set separate limits for video and photos
 - Checks 30s after cold start and every hour
 - Deletes oldest files when limit exceeded
 (leave empty or 0 for no limit)

* Recording Status:
 - Shows time and segment count in top-right
 - Double-tap to toggle show/hide

* Timestamp Overlay:
 - Adds time watermark to saved videos/photos
 - Only affects saved files, not preview
 - Video overlay only in MediaCodec mode

* Auto Start on Boot: Auto launch on system boot

* Auto Start Recording:
 - Auto start recording when app launches
 - Auto resume when returning to foreground
 - Keep recording with foreground service

* Screen Off Recording:
 - Only available when auto-start recording is on
 - ON: Continue recording when screen is off
 - OFF: Stop recording 10s after screen off
 - Resume 10s after screen on

* Keep Alive: Wake every 15 minutes

* Prevent Sleep: Block deep sleep
 - Receive messages after engine off
 - Increases battery drain, enable as needed

* Floating Window: Show floating recording button
